recursos.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original wide 16:9 pixel-art videogame main menu background, full bleed, illustration only.
Primary request: Create an espionage thriller rainy-night scene for NO TRACE. A special operations agent with realistic tactical gear stands at the right third facing left toward a clandestine industrial compound. Three-quarter back view, head and full body readable, natural infiltration stance, arms holding a coherent compact rifle low across his side, muzzle pointing left-down. Fine chunky pixel art with crisp visible pixels, thoughtful pixel clusters, atmospheric depth.
Scene/backdrop: dark blue-black industrial base, concrete guard tower near center, rain-slick pavement, sparse warm windows, red security signal lamps, moody cold spotlights. Perspective follows isometric/axonometric game art direction subtly while preserving convincing anatomy.
Composition/framing: WIDE 16:9 horizontal image. Left 40 percent nearly black empty negative space with minimal indistinct texture for UI; no agent or bright structures on left. Buildings occupy center, agent entirely in right 35 percent. Leave ample dark lower edge and upper left. Camera eye level.
Lighting/mood: midnight covert operation, restrained blue-gray moonlight, thin muted red rim lighting on agent, wet reflections center-right, dark overall but readable. High craft pixel-art game key art.
Constraints: No lettering, no logos, no watermark, no interface elements, no buttons, no borders, no cursors. This is a single illustrated background, not a sprite sheet. Do not imitate a known franchise. Need original composition.
recursos.nota: Ilustración original estática, presentada sin movimiento ni lluvia animada en NO TRACE; no contiene fotogramas de personaje.

recursos.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original typographic title logo for a tactical infiltration videogame named NO TRACE. One isolated horizontal logo, transparent background.
Primary request: Render exactly the two words "NO TRACE" in ALL CAPITALS. Custom drawn powerful condensed extended military techno lettering, forward slanted, strongly shaped engineered letterforms with angular cutouts and stencil breaks; premium original gaming identity, NOT just text set in a generic typeface.
Composition: Wide horizontal wordmark about 4.4:1 width to height. Letters bright off-white and restrained light-gray wear, subtle distressed small missing pixels and tiny speedline interruptions integrated into selected edges without compromising readability. A single narrow red diagonal cut/slash through the space between NO and TRACE, restrained red accent.
Text (verbatim): "NO TRACE". N O space T R A C E. No other letters, no subtitle.
Constraints: Genuine alpha transparency, no backdrop, no gradients behind the logo, no checkerboard, no framing box, no border, no cast shadow, no watermark, no mockup presentation, no icon/emblem. Transparent empty margins modest about 4 percent. Logo will be drawn over a near-black pixel art background. Must be crisp and legible at 450-pixel width. Original lettering design.
recursos.nota: PNG original sin edición posterior. El área transparente exterior contiene alfa residual menor a 64.
